summary: Helus Pharma Inc. (formerly Cybin Inc.) filed a Form 6-K with an attached Canadian Form 51-102F3 Material Change Report and news release announcing completion of a legal name change effective October 1, 2026. Shareholders approved the change at the annual and special meeting held September 22, 2026. The Nasdaq and Cboe Canada ticker remains HELP; new CUSIP 423492107 and ISIN CA4234921076 were assigned. Outstanding certificates and DRS statements remain valid. No capital, ownership, or structural terms changed. This is a routine corporate housekeeping event, not a special situation.
